name: VX-670
sort_evidence: VX-670 is an Entrada-licensed cyclic-peptide-conjugated oligonucleotide for DM1 with Phase 1/2 GALILEO (NCT06185764) active and an extension (NCT06926621) enrolling, not in the VRTX book (https://www.vrtx.com/our-science/pipeline/myotonic-dystrophy-type-1/).

trials.title: A Study of Long-term Safety and Efficacy of VX-670 in Participants With Myotonic Dystrophy Type I
